title: Great practice and amazing caring staff
content: Over the past 2 years I have had to contact the surgery numerous times. I have always received same day appointments  either in person or telephone consultation. Every single member of staff I have come across at this surgery has been nothing but exceptional and this includes not only the medical staff but the receptionists too. Doctors follow up when they say they will and explain processes and procedures in detail. Great service, keep up the good work.
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
